name: Qiang Zhu
description: Qiang Zhu brings a wealth of experience in application development to his role as Head of Engineering. He previously served as Director of Engineering at Camera360, a leading image and video mobile application company, and as a Tech Lead at Adobe, where he contributed to one of the industry's most widely used software solutions. He is also the co-author of EIP-6821 and co-founder of Web3Builder.tech, with active contributions to the Ethereum ecosystem.
